name: io.github.vAPI-Network/vapi-network
title: vAPI Network
description: vAPI Network: local, non-custodial MCP server to discover and pay x402 APIs in USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: VAPI_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to local vAPI state. Defaults to .vapi under the user home directory.

environmentVariables.name: VAPI_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Initial local account name. Defaults to the account selected in wallets.json.

environmentVariables.name: VAPI_VAULT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for a protected local vault. Optional with an unlocked vault session; no vault needed for docs tools.

environmentVariables.name: BASE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Base RPC endpoint used by account and payment tools.
